responsibility: This file implements NDS32 interrupt, exception, and reset handler support driven by function attributes. It parses modern and backward-compatible attribute forms, records vector metadata such as handler category, vector id, save policy, nesting mode, security level, and reset companions, and emits the assembler-side ISR vector/jump-table sections at file start/end. It also provides queries that identify ISR functions and critical handlers, making it the backend component that connects source attributes to target-specific interrupt-vector assembly output.
